lines.text: God measured the waters in the hollow of His hand and needed no counselor to teach Him.
The nations are like a drop in a bucket, and Lebanon is not sufficient for fuel.
One lacking such an offering chooses stone that will not rot and seeks a skilled craftsman.
God sits above the circle of the earth, and its dwellers are like cedars.
The LORD will not grow tired, and those who wait upon Him will mount up with wings like eagles.
